vb_textbox.text: Use the first few decisions on each round to test each of the coloured gnomes to see what they reward. They do seem to vary slightly during the later rounds, some times giving 0 instead of the amount they normally give, but generally, the gnomes that are better early on, remain better throughout most of the rounds. Try and remember what each gnome gives and what colour to pick from each pair, then repeat the colours in your head (if green is better than yellow, bright pink better than purple, brown is better than light pink, blue is better than orange, repeat green, bright pink, brown, blue in your head so that you can remember which colour to go for). If a gnome gives 0 points for a round, continue to go with it in future rounds as all will occasionally give 0, but will return to their usual amount. When you go on to the second, third, fourth, etc, section/round, the value each gnome gives may change, so use the first few decisions to once again test each one. Good luck!
